scripts.bundle:products-api: npm run clean:dist && esbuild src/products/getProductsListHandler.ts src/products/getProductByIdHandler.ts src/products/createProductHandler.ts src/products/catalogBatchProcessHandler.ts --bundle --platform=node --tree-shaking --target=node20 --minify --keep-names --outdir=dist
scripts.bundle:products: npm run bundle:products-api && npm run bundle:import-service
scripts.bundle:all: npm run clean && npm run bundle:products
scripts.bundle:watch: npm run bundle:products-api -- --watch & npm run bundle:import-service -- --watch
scripts.deploy:bootstrap: cd infra && npx cdk bootstrap aws://410859982763/us-east-1 --profile cloudx-js
scripts.deploy:all: npm run pre-deploy && cd infra && npx cdk deploy --all --profile cloudx-js --require-approval never
scripts.deploy:db: npm run pre-deploy && cd infra && npx cdk deploy ProductsDbStack --profile cloudx-js
scripts.deploy:api: npm run pre-deploy && cd infra && npx cdk deploy ProductsApiStack --profile cloudx-js
scripts.deploy:import: npm run pre-deploy && cd infra && npx cdk deploy ImportServiceStack --profile cloudx-js
scripts.deploy:sqs: npm run pre-deploy && cd infra && npx cdk deploy CatalogSqs --profile cloudx-js
scripts.deploy:sns: npm run pre-deploy && cd infra && npx cdk deploy ProductSnsStack --profile cloudx-js
scripts.deploy:cart-db: cd infra && npx cdk deploy CartDbStack --profile cloudx-js
scripts.deploy:cart-api: cd infra && npx cdk deploy CartApiStack --profile cloudx-js
scripts.deploy:cart: cd infra && npx cdk deploy CartDbStack CartApiStack --profile cloudx-js
scripts.cdk:diff: cd infra && npx cdk diff --profile cloudx-js
scripts.cdk:synth: cd infra && npx cdk synth --profile cloudx-js
scripts.cdk:destroy: cd infra && npx cdk destroy --all --profile cloudx-js
